question: What is the cooling-off period for a new life insurance policy?
context: Under the Insurance Contracts Act 1984, customers have a 14-day cooling-off period from the date they receive the policy document to cancel and receive a full refund, provided no claim has been made.
ground_truth_answer: The cooling-off period for a new life insurance policy is 14 days from the date you receive the policy document. You can cancel and receive a full refund if no claim has been made.
model_answer: The cooling-off period is 14 days from receipt of the policy document, with a full refund available provided no claim has been made.

question: What is the total and permanent disability (TPD) definition?
context: TPD cover pays if you are unlikely to ever work again in any occupation for which you are suited by education, training, or experience (Any Occupation definition), or in your own occupation (Own Occupation definition). The applicable definition is stated in your policy schedule.
ground_truth_answer: TPD pays when you are unlikely to ever work again. Any Occupation TPD requires being unable to work in any suitable role; Own Occupation requires being unable to perform your own job. Your policy schedule states which applies.

question: Can I claim income protection insurance if I am self-employed?
context: Self-employed individuals can take out income protection insurance. Benefits are typically calculated on the lower of the insured benefit amount and 75% of pre-disability income, based on the last 12 months' tax returns or financials.

question: What happens if I miss a premium payment?

question: What is the duty of disclosure?
context: Under the Insurance Contracts Act 1984, you must disclose every matter that you know, or could reasonably be expected to know, that is relevant to an insurer's decision to insure you. Failure to disclose may allow the insurer to avoid the contract or reduce a claim.
ground_truth_answer: You must disclose every matter you know or should know that is relevant to the insurer's decision. Failure to disclose may allow the insurer to void the contract or reduce a claim under the Insurance Contracts Act 1984.

question: What does the Internal Dispute Resolution (IDR) process involve?

question: Is flood damage the same as storm damage under my home insurance?
